notes: Curated condition registry (DATA_SCHEMA_SPEC §2.9). Every entry cites a wiki page (wikiTitle) whose existence is checked by the fetch stage; descriptions are definitional and carry no numbers that are not on the cited page.

match.stations: recipe station tokens (Cargo Recipes `station`, split on ' and '). match.recipeNotes: Cargo Recipes `resulttext` note keys (texts in Module:Recipes/l10n en.result_note). match.dropNotes: parenthesized note texts in Cargo Drops rate/custom cells (markup stripped). match.dropCaptions: group captions of a registry boss article's rendered drop list ("Only in Corrupt worlds"), which the Cargo rows do not carry (parse/dropCaptions.ts).

AMENDMENTS-014 B68 / AMENDMENTS-015 B78 (P4-prep gating expansion, 2026-10-14): post-queen-bee (Witch Doctor availability), goblin-army-defeated (Goblin Tinkerer availability; an event with no progression edge, so it is a requirement chip, never a boss gate) and blood-moon (NPC shop rows) were added for overlays/vendors.json; the six <ore>-ore-world conditions carry the world-specific ore-bar chest loot (overlays/containers.json worldSpecificLoot). `exhaustive` lists non-node condition groups every world satisfies one member of (the world evil): an either-or over such a group is always satisfiable, so the §7b minimum over e.g. a Shadow Orb route (Corruption worlds) and a Crimson Heart route (Crimson worlds) carries neither condition (merge/gating.ts). Each group is quote-backed (checked verbatim against the cached article); pipeline-only, not emitted.

P6-S0 (2026-10-15): match.fishingConditions maps the condition labels of the "Fishing catches" article (its World status / generic definitions; for the Dungeon, the biome definition's requirement "Skeletron is defeated") onto these slugs for fishing routes (merge/fishing.ts, AMENDMENTS-004 B20); angler-quest and can-fish-in-lava are the two fishing conditions it defines, quoted in their descriptions. hellforge-absent is Skeletron's Hellforge drop condition (its drop-list caption and Cargo note, AMENDMENTS-015 B84 queue), the jungle-temple-absent family.

satisfiedByNode values are references into the progression graph (P2-S6, overlays/progression.json + bosses.json) and are hard-checked. World-state conditions map to the node that makes them true: boss-defeat conditions to the boss node, "hardmode" to the Hardmode milestone (required-gated by wall-of-flesh) and post-mechanical-bosses to the all-mechanical-bosses milestone, so gatedBy.stage is the stage the condition opens (a Hardmode-only item is early-hm, not the late-prehm of the Wall of Flesh fight).

exhaustive.quote: Corruption or Crimson is saved as the world's naturally generated evil biome, and determines: whether Shadow Orbs or Crimson Hearts are generated
exhaustive.why: Every world saves exactly one naturally generated evil biome (Drunk worlds carry both), so 'Corruption world OR Crimson world' holds in every world.

exhaustive.quote: A world will generally only contain one ore type from each tier, which is chosen at random.
exhaustive.why: One ore of each tier per world, so 'Iron Ore world OR Lead Ore world' holds in every world (Drunk worlds carry both).
